title: Who’s Asking? Evaluating LLM Robustness to Inquiry Personas in Factual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM factual accuracy, context relevance, and response styles when prompted with first-person personas of varying domain expertise (e.g., high school student vs. senior professor).
Evaluating LLM responses to user personas representing different reading comprehension levels (foundational, developing, advanced) to measure shifts in language complexity and factual correctness.
Analyzing LLM responses to credulous versus skeptical personas to measure variations in accuracy and stereotype risk, such as the model adopting a patronizing tone or delivering unsolicited lectures.

Prompting LLMs with unaligned professional personas (e.g., safecracker, orthodontist) and measuring whether the model stereotypes the user, improperly adopts the persona's identity, or refuses to answer objective facts based on the user's background.
